name: vibegit
description: Save and inspect local project checkpoints through VibeGit.

interface.shortDescription: 在对话中保存、查询和比较项目存档。
interface.longDescription: Save a real local checkpoint of the current protected project, inspect its history, and compare changes. Uses the same project registry and checkpoints as VibeGit desktop. Requires Node.js 24+ and Git on this computer.
defaultPrompt: 查看当前项目最近的存档
